name: NINA Emergency Warnings
description: Access official German emergency warnings and alerts from the NINA Warn-App (BBK). Get current warnings for floods, storms, fires, and other emergencies by region.

tools.name: nina_get_active_warnings
tools.description: All currently active warnings of one source, nationwide: mowas (civil protection / MoWaS), katwarn, biwapp, dwd (severe weather), lhp (flood), police. Each item has an id (pass it to nina_get_warning_detail), headline, severity, sent time and affected areas. An empty list means no active warning from that source.

tools.name: nina_get_warnings_by_region
tools.description: Get current emergency warnings for a specific German region (Kreis/Stadt) by its AGS code. AGS is the official municipality key (Amtlicher Gemeindeschlüssel). Use the first 5 digits for Kreis level.

ags.description: The 12-digit AGS code of the region (e.g. '091620000000' for Munich, '110000000000' for Berlin). Use 5 digits + trailing zeros.

tools.name: nina_get_warning_detail
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific warning by its ID. Returns the full warning text, affected areas, instructions, and severity level.

warningId.description: The warning ID (obtained from dashboard or region warnings)

tools.name: nina_get_covid_rules
tools.description: Get current COVID-19 rules and regulations for a specific German region by AGS code.

ags.description: The 12-digit AGS code of the region
